headline: Colts To Contact Peyton Manning About GM Job?
summary: The Colts fired longtime general manager Chris Ballard on Monday, putting them in the market for a new leader of football operations for the first time since 2017. headline: Fallout From Chris Ballard’s Firing: Steichen, Jones, Trade Possibilities
summary: The Colts entered 2026 mired in a five-year playoff drought, and though it’s still early, it does not appear they will break it this season. headline: Rams put Davante Adams, Poona Ford on IR
summary: Wide receiver Davante Adams is expected to miss the next 6-10 weeks after rupturing his hamstring in last Sunday's loss to the Cardinals and the Rams moved him off of the active roster on Tuesday.

headline: Bills' Sam Franklin suspended one game for spitting; will appeal, per sources
summary: Bills defensive back Sam Franklin Jr. was suspended one game for unsportsmanlike conduct that the league said was a spitting incident against the Raiders.
